reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Vermont
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant raise "any legal defense" available to them?
    The statement is true when the relevant law refers broadly to all defenses that might be raised.

    Note: The provided statutes (32 V.S.A.  4464-4465; 26 V.S.A.  4458-4459) concern tax appeal
    withdrawal/hearing officers and professional licensing renewals/fees, not eviction defenses.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic helpers (pure Prolog; no external modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

is_before_heard(before_heard).
is_before_heard(any_time_before_heard).

max_per_diem_allowed(150).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state_year(vermont, 2021).

% Eviction action context
case(case1).
case_type(case1, eviction_action).
party(tenant1).
role_in_case(tenant1, case1, tenant).

% The tenant attempts to raise broad defenses
tenant_seeks_to_raise_any_legal_defense(tenant1, case1).

/* scenario_statement/0
   Succeeds exactly when the encoded factual scenario is present:
   - an eviction action
   - a tenant in that eviction action
   - tenant seeks to raise "any legal defense"
*/
scenario_statement :-
    case(Case),
    case_type(Case, eviction_action),
    party(Tenant),
    role_in_case(Tenant, Case, tenant),
    tenant_seeks_to_raise_any_legal_defense(Tenant, Case),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (as deterministic predicates with citations)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* 32 V.S.A.  4464 - Withdrawal of appeal

   - On application to the Director, an appellant may request leave to withdraw an appeal
     at any time before it is heard.
   - When an appeal is withdrawn, Director shall certify to town clerk; clerk records.
   - The appraisal becomes part of the appraisal/grand list of the taxpayer.

   We encode the core legal effects as predicates about an appeal's status and required acts.
*/

% appeal_withdrawal_allowed(+Appellant,+Appeal,+TimeMarker).
% TimeMarker must indicate "before heard".
appeal_withdrawal_allowed(Appellant, Appeal, TimeMarker) :-
    appeal_appellant(Appeal, Appellant),
    appeal_forum(Appeal, director),
    is_before_heard(TimeMarker),
    appeal_is_heard(Appeal, no),
    !.

% withdrawal_effects_triggered(+Appeal) is true when an appeal has been withdrawn.
withdrawal_effects_triggered(Appeal) :-
    appeal_status(Appeal, withdrawn),
    !.

% director_must_certify_withdrawal(+Appeal) (to town clerk of originating town).
director_must_certify_withdrawal(Appeal) :-
    withdrawal_effects_triggered(Appeal),
    appeal_origin_town(Appeal, _Town),
    !.

% town_clerk_must_record_withdrawal_certificate(+Appeal).
town_clerk_must_record_withdrawal_certificate(Appeal) :-
    withdrawal_effects_triggered(Appeal),
    !.

% appraisal_becomes_part_of_grand_list(+Taxpayer,+Appraisal,+Appeal) after withdrawal.
appraisal_becomes_part_of_grand_list(Taxpayer, Appraisal, Appeal) :-
    withdrawal_effects_triggered(Appeal),
    appeal_taxpayer(Appeal, Taxpayer),
    appeal_appraisal(Appeal, Appraisal),
    !.

/* 32 V.S.A.  4465 - Appointment of property valuation hearing officer; oath; pay

   - When an appeal to the Director is not withdrawn, Director shall refer appeal in writing
     to a hearing officer not employed by Director.
   - Director can remove hearing officer for inefficiency, malfeasance, or other cause.
   - Hearing officer must take oath; filed with Director.
   - Director pays per diem not to exceed $150 per day of hearings + reasonable expenses.
   - Hearing officer may subpoena and administer oaths.

   Encoded as conditions and attributes.
*/

% appeal_requires_hearing_officer_referral(+Appeal) when not withdrawn.
appeal_requires_hearing_officer_referral(Appeal) :-
    appeal_forum(Appeal, director),
    appeal_status(Appeal, Status),
    Status \= withdrawn,
    !.

% hearing_officer_eligibility(+Officer) must not be employed by Director.
hearing_officer_eligibility(Officer) :-
    person(Officer),
    employed_by_director(Officer, no),
    !.

% director_must_refer_to_hearing_officer(+Appeal,+Officer).
director_must_refer_to_hearing_officer(Appeal, Officer) :-
    appeal_requires_hearing_officer_referral(Appeal),
    hearing_officer_eligibility(Officer),
    !.

% hearing_officer_removal_ground/1 encodes statutory grounds (open-ended "or other cause").
hearing_officer_removal_ground(inefficiency) :- !.
hearing_officer_removal_ground(malfeasance) :- !.
hearing_officer_removal_ground(other_cause) :- !.

% hearing_officer_pay_per_diem_cap(+CapDollars).
hearing_officer_pay_per_diem_cap(Cap) :-
    max_per_diem_allowed(Cap),
    !.

% hearing_officer_has_power(+Officer,+Power).
hearing_officer_has_power(Officer, subpoena_witnesses_records_documents) :-
    person(Officer),
    !.
hearing_officer_has_power(Officer, administer_oaths_to_witnesses) :-
    person(Officer),
    !.

/* 26 V.S.A.  4458 - Renewals; continuing education

   - License renewed on schedule set by Director upon payment of renewal fee,
     provided applicant completes professional development per Director-approved processes.
   - Director shall establish, by rule, guidelines and criteria for renewal or reinstatement.

   Encoded as renewal conditions and director obligations.
*/

% license_renewal_allowed(+Licensee,+License) if fee paid and professional development completed.
license_renewal_allowed(Licensee, License) :-
    holds_license(Licensee, License),
    renewal_fee_paid(Licensee, License, yes),
    professional_development_completed(Licensee, License, yes),
    !.

% director_must_establish_renewal_rules/0.
director_must_establish_renewal_rules :-
    director_exists(yes),
    !.

/* 26 V.S.A.  4459 - Fees

   - Each applicant and licensee shall pay fees set forth in 3 V.S.A.  125.

   We encode a generic obligation to pay the statutory schedule.
*/

% must_pay_fee_schedule_3_vsa_125(+Person) for applicants and licensees.
must_pay_fee_schedule_3_vsa_125(Person) :-
    ( is_applicant(Person, yes)
    ; is_licensee(Person, yes)
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Minimal background facts for statute predicates (not part of scenario)
%% (These are generic placeholders to keep statute predicates meaningful.)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

director_exists(yes).

% Generic "person" universe to support hearing officer predicates.
person(hearing_officer1).

employed_by_director(hearing_officer1, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning for the eviction-defense question
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question asks whether, in an eviction action, the tenant can raise "any legal defense"
   *when the relevant law refers broadly to all defenses that might be raised*.

   We therefore model: if there exists a relevant statute/rule in Vermont (2021) that grants
   a broad right to raise any defenses in eviction, then answer yes; otherwise no.

   The provided statutes do not address eviction defenses at all, so the predicate below
   will fail, yielding 'no' by rule.
*/

% statute_provides_broad_eviction_defenses(+State,+Year)
% True only if encoded statutes contain an eviction-defense provision.
statute_provides_broad_eviction_defenses(_State, _Year) :-
    % None of the provided statutes mention eviction actions or tenant defenses.
    fail.

% tenant_may_raise_any_legal_defense_in_eviction(+State,+Year) derived from statutes.
tenant_may_raise_any_legal_defense_in_eviction(State, Year) :-
    statute_provides_broad_eviction_defenses(State, Year),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state_year(State, Year),
    ( tenant_may_raise_any_legal_defense_in_eviction(State, Year)
    -> Result = yes
    ;  Result = no
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant raise "any legal defense" available to them? This is true when the relevant law refers broadly to all defenses that might be raised.
